Spell words, build your board, and bend the rules with mods, all to the soothing thock of the mechanical keyboard. Make every key count Shape your board with four kinds of items: Function keys : powerful passives that boost your words. Tired of spelling long words? Grab a function key that'll make short words knock your socks off. Strapped for cash? Have your function keys make money for you! Key caps : these colorful upgrades don't just buff your favorite letters, they buff their neighbors too! Align them just right to make a chain reaction of color and light across your whole keyboard! Tools : reusable gadgets with a few charges each. Tape letters together to form an "ing" key, swap around keys using portals, or disguise your keys to hide them from debuffs. Mods : ultra rare items that change the rules of the game. Tell the spellchecker to take a break or trade your energy in for cash, it's up to you to decide. detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Func Key is a word-spelling roguelike where your keyboard is your class: six boards, six different ways to play. Spell words, build your board, and bend the rules with mods, all to the soothing thock of the mechanical keyboard.

Make every key count

Shape your board with four kinds of items:

  • Function keys: powerful passives that boost your words. Tired of spelling long words? Grab a function key that'll make short words knock your socks off. Strapped for cash? Have your function keys make money for you!

  • Key caps: these colorful upgrades don't just buff your favorite letters, they buff their neighbors too! Align them just right to make a chain reaction of color and light across your whole keyboard!

  • Tools: reusable gadgets with a few charges each. Tape letters together to form an "ing" key, swap around keys using portals, or disguise your keys to hide them from debuffs.

  • Mods: ultra rare items that change the rules of the game. Tell the spellchecker to take a break or trade your energy in for cash, it's up to you to decide.

Pick your playstyle

Choose from any of 6 keyboards to start your run. These aren't simply skins or stat bonuses - each comes with new mechanics, synergies and ways to play.

Express yourself

Customize your keyboard with over 30 cosmetics: shape, color, font, and even sound!

Features

  • 6 playable keyboards

  • 5 difficulty levels

  • 85 function keys

  • 28 consumables

  • 32 cosmetics

  • 16 bosses

  • 12 mods

  • endless mode

  • daily challenges
